Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a peptidomics study focusing on endogenous plasma peptides. While PRIDE metadata lists 'Top-down proteomics', the methods describe a 'no-digest' search of endogenous peptides (peptidomics) rather than intact protein analysis of the whole proteome. Acquisition is DDA (TopN). Quantification is label-free relative to an internal standard.

scope: Plasma samples from two patients with pancreatic neuroendocrine tumours were extracted using an established acetonitrile‐based plasma peptide enrichment strategy.

Plasma was precipitated using an acetonitrile based extraction method.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The analyzed material is the plasma peptidome (endogenous peptides), which falls under the secretome scope as it consists of proteins/peptides secreted into a biofluid. The use of acetonitrile precipitation and SPE was to enrich the low molecular weight peptidome by removing high-abundance proteins.
